_about: The liftable wreck (Game Design 23d section 8 item 20, the Cyborg's Wreck Toss; Legal RL-183 and ln04: wreckage and metal only, empty, nothing living near; read by sim/world/wrecks.gd). A wreck is a building that has fallen and has not been hurled. reachBh: how near the fighter must be (in body heights, to the wreck's box). nearBh: no living civilian stands in a building within this many body heights of the wreck's edge (people are people in standing buildings; fighters are not counted unless fighters is true). fill: a wreck's mass is this share of its building's volume, in cubic body heights (the piece a fighter can take hold of, not the whole heap). minMass: a smaller wreck is not worth lifting. tierLift: the heaviest wreck each tier (1 to 4) lifts, in the same unit: Game Design and Combat's numbers to confirm; Encounter may pass its own. burst: the scrap's damage to structures when the wreck is hurled and lands: speed times the brunt ladder's tier factor and bruntMul (the same ladder as a body's brunt), scaled by the square root of the wreck's mass over massRef (kept within scaleMin and scaleMax), over a radius of radiusBh body heights likewise scaled and kept within radiusMinBh and radiusMaxBh.
